## How The Course Works
- Signup free in 30 seconds to save progress.
- Read 1 lesson in simple English with live examples.
- Try code in Playground.
- Give 10-question test in 3 minutes. 100 marks. Score 80+ to pass and unlock next lesson.
- Lesson 50 is Final Exam - 20 questions in 10 minutes. Pass with 80% and get Certificate.
- 1 lesson per day = Finish in 50 days. 2 lessons per day = Finish in 25 days.
- All lessons work on mobile, tablet and laptop. No laptop or installation needed.

## Key Topics Covered
- HTML: h1-h6, p, a href, img src alt, ul ol li, table, form, input, button, div, span, header nav main section footer
- CSS: colors, background, text styling, box model, margin padding border, flexbox, grid, responsive design, media queries, buttons, forms styling
- JavaScript: let const var, data types, if-else, loops for while, functions, arrays push filter map, objects, strings split reverse join, DOM getElementById innerText innerHTML, events onclick, form validation, localStorage setItem getItem, timers setTimeout setInterval, fetch API
- Projects: Calculator, To-Do List, Quiz App, Password Generator, Weather App, Portfolio, Landing Page, Full Website, Shop with Cart
- Career: SEO - Title Tag Meta Description Headings Alt Text, Deploy - index.html Netlify Drop, Freelancing - 50% advance pricing proposal, Interview - == vs === Flexbox vs Grid Box Model

- Freelancers who want to earn on Fiverr, Upwork and local clients - Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 100,000 per website.
- Anyone in Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, USA, UK, UAE, Saudi Arabia who can use a mobile phone.
